metadata.name: SBP ETGRMF
metadata.description: The Enterprise Technology Governance and Risk Management Framework (ETGRMF) is a mandatory regulatory framework issued by the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) for financial institutions to ensure robust IT governance, information security, and operational resilience.
metadata.classification_reasoning: The SBP ETGRMF is a mandatory regulatory framework issued by the State Bank of Pakistan for financial institutions operating under its jurisdiction.
metadata.framework_purpose: To establish comprehensive technology governance and risk management requirements for financial institutions in Pakistan.
metadata.framework_scope: All financial institutions regulated by the State Bank of Pakistan, including banks, DFIs, microfinance banks, and other entities under SBP's supervisory purview.
framework_objectives: Establish effective IT governance structures aligned with business objectives
Ensure robust IT service delivery and operations management
Manage technology acquisition and implementation risks
Maintain business continuity and disaster recovery capabilities
Enable effective IT audit and oversight mechanisms
metadata.target_audience: CIOs, CISOs, IT Governance Teams, Compliance Officers, Internal Auditors, and Board Members of SBP-regulated financial institutions
metadata.penalty_for_non_compliance: Non-compliance may result in regulatory penalties, restrictions, and enforcement actions as per SBP regulations and the Banking Companies Ordinance.
adoption_approach: Review current IT governance and security practices against framework requirements
Conduct gap assessment across all six framework domains
Develop implementation roadmap with prioritized action items
Implement required controls and governance structures
Establish ongoing monitoring and reporting mechanisms
Submit compliance reports to SBP as required

controls.title: Board responsibility to establish technology governance framework
controls.description: The Board must create a governance framework to ensure technology aligns with and supports the organization's goals.
controls.full_text: The Board of Directors of the FI(s) are responsible to establish a comprehensive enterprise technology governance framework which defines the leadership, organizational structures and processes to ensure that the FI(s)' technology sustains and extends the enterprise's strategies and objectives.
controls.ai_notes: Clear directive for the Board to establish a governance framework.

controls.ai_notes: Mandatory establishment of Board IT Committee with specific applicability criteria.

controls.title: Board IT Committee membership requirements
controls.description: The Board IT Committee shall have a minimum of three directors, one of whom shall be an independent director and at least one member shall have relevant IT qualification or experience.
controls.full_text: The Board IT Committee shall have a minimum of three (03) directors as its members, one of whom shall be an independent director and at least one member shall have relevant qualification or experience of IT.
controls.ai_notes: Explicit membership requirements for Board IT Committee.

evidence_requirements.name: Independence Declarations

controls.title: Board IT Committee advisory and reporting responsibilities
controls.description: The committee shall be mainly responsible for advising and reporting to the board on the status of technology activities and digital initiatives, enabling the board to make decisions without being involved in routine activities.
controls.full_text: The committee shall be mainly responsible for advising and reporting to the board on the status of technology activities and digital initiatives in the FI(s). These reports shall enable the board to make decisions without having to be involved in routine activities.
controls.ai_notes: Clear responsibility for committee to advise and report to board.

evidence_requirements.name: BITC Reports to Board

evidence_requirements.name: Board Minutes Receiving BITC Reports

evidence_requirements.name: BITC TOR Extract on Reporting Duties

controls.title: Board IT Committee review of IT and Digital strategies

controls.full_text: The committee shall review IT and Digital strategies and relevant policies before submission to the board.
controls.ai_notes: Mandatory review of strategies and policies before board submission.

evidence_requirements.name: BITC Pre-Review Minutes

evidence_requirements.name: Pre-Submission Approval Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log tracking BITC pre-approval dates for each strategy/policy going to the board.

controls.title: Ensure risk management strategies for resilience
controls.description: The committee shall ensure that risk management strategies are designed and implemented to achieve resilience, including effective response to wide-scale disruptions, cyber attacks and attacks on multiple critical infrastructure sectors.
controls.full_text: The committee shall ensure that risk management strategies are designed and implemented to achieve resilience, such as the ability to effectively respond to wide-scale disruptions, including cyber attacks and attacks on multiple critical infrastructure sectors.
controls.ai_notes: Mandatory requirement to ensure resilience through risk management strategies.

evidence_requirements.name: Operational Resilience Strategy
evidence_requirements.description: Documented operational resilience strategy covering response to wide-scale disruptions, cyber attacks and critical infrastructure events.

evidence_requirements.name: BITC Resilience Oversight Minutes
evidence_requirements.description: BITC minutes evidencing oversight of risk management strategies for resilience.

evidence_requirements.name: Cyber Crisis Response Plan
evidence_requirements.description: Cyber crisis response plan for simulating and handling extreme disruption scenarios.

evidence_requirements.name: Resilience Scenario Test Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Reports of resilience testing exercises (wide-scale disruption, multi-sector attack simulations).

controls.title: Board IT Committee monitoring of technology projects
controls.description: The committee shall receive periodic updates from IT Steering Committee to monitor all technology-related projects approved by the board.
controls.full_text: The committee shall receive periodic updates from IT Steering Committee to monitor all technology-related projects approved by the board.
controls.ai_notes: Periodic updates to monitor board-approved technology projects are required.

evidence_requirements.description: Periodic project status reports submitted by IT Steering Committee to BITC on board-approved technology projects.

evidence_requirements.name: Procurement Register

controls.full_text: If deem necessary, the committee may seek expert opinion from independent sources.

controls.title: IT Steering Committee cross-functional composition
controls.description: The committee shall be formulated with senior officials from different functions including IT, information security, risk management, compliance, operations and business segments.
controls.full_text: The committee shall be formulated with senior officials from different functions including IT, information security, risk management, compliance, operations and business segments.
controls.ai_notes: Cross-functional composition is explicitly required.

evidence_requirements.name: Attendance Register

controls.title: IT Steering Committee advisory role to senior management
controls.description: The committee shall assist the senior management in implementing IT and digital strategies approved by the BoD and shall also play an advisory role to the senior management in all technology-related matters.
controls.full_text: The committee shall assist the senior management in implementing IT and digital strategies approved by the BoD and shall also play an advisory role to the senior management in all technology-related matters.

controls.title: IT Steering Committee monitoring of technology projects

controls.full_text: The committee shall monitor implementation of all technology-related projects.

evidence_requirements.description: ITSC minutes documenting project implementation reviews and decisions/directions.

evidence_requirements.description: Register of project escalations addressed by ITSC.

controls.title: Ensure IT procurement aligns with business plan

controls.full_text: The committee shall ensure that IT procurement is in line with the business plan.
controls.ai_notes: Alignment of IT procurement with business plan is required.

evidence_requirements.name: Business Plan Reference Document
evidence_requirements.description: Current business plan referenced by ITSC when assessing IT procurement alignment.

evidence_requirements.name: Procurement-Business Plan Alignment Matrix
evidence_requirements.description: Matrix linking each major IT procurement to specific business plan objectives.

evidence_requirements.description: ITSC minutes documenting review of procurement proposals against business plan.

evidence_requirements.name: Procurement Approval Memos
evidence_requirements.description: Approval memos for IT procurements citing business plan alignment.

controls.title: Ensure CSP outsourcing aligns with SLA
controls.description: Ensure that the outsourcing to Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) is conducted in line with the Service Level Agreement.

controls.ai_notes: SLA compliance for CSP outsourcing is mandatory.

evidence_requirements.name: SLA Breach Register

controls.title: Ensure efficient IT operating environment

evidence_requirements.name: Benchmark & Review Records
evidence_requirements.description: Periodic benchmarking/review records confirming structure remains commensurate with FI profile.

controls.title: Head of Information Security/CISO responsibilities
controls.description: The head of information security/CISO shall be responsible for management and mitigation of information/cyber security risks across the enterprise and devising strategies to monitor and address current and emerging risks.
controls.full_text: The head of information security/CISO shall be responsible for management and mitigation of information/cyber security risks across the enterprise and devising strategies to monitor and address current and emerging risks.
controls.ai_notes: Mandatory CISO responsibilities covering enterprise-wide security risk management.

evidence_requirements.description: Formal CISO/Head of Information Security job description covering enterprise-wide security risk management and emerging risk strategies.

evidence_requirements.name: CISO KPIs
evidence_requirements.description: Defined CISO KPIs covering risk management and mitigation effectiveness across the enterprise.

controls.title: Independence of CISO from technology function
controls.description: The head of information security/CISO shall be independent of the technology function to avoid any conflict of interest.
controls.full_text: The head of information security /CISO shall be independent of the technology function to avoid any conflict of interest.

controls.description: FIs shall formulate a technology policy framework reviewed and updated at least every three years, covering information/cyber security, services delivery and operations, project management and acquisition, and business continuity and disaster recovery.
controls.full_text: The FI(s) shall formulate technology policy framework which shall be reviewed and updated at-least after every three (03) years. This framework, at a minimum, shall cover the following areas: i) Information/cyber Security ii) Services delivery & operations management iii) Project management, acquisition, development & implementation of technology solutions/systems iv) Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery
controls.ai_notes: Mandatory technology policy framework with defined minimum coverage areas and 3-year review cycle.

evidence_requirements.description: Report demonstrating coverage of all four mandatory framework domains.

controls.full_text: The BoD shall put in place an appropriate MIS to oversee the implementation of IT strategy and business plan, exception from board-approved IT policies and progress on major IT projects. controls.ai_notes: Incident reporting is a mandatory component of the IS framework.

evidence_requirements.name: Information Sharing Log

controls.title: Protect critical information system assets
controls.description: FIs shall adequately protect critical information system assets from unauthorized access, misuse or fraudulent modification, insertion, deletion, substitution, suppression or disclosure.
controls.full_text: FI(s) shall adequately protect critical information system assets from unauthorized access, misuse or fraudulent modification, insertion, deletion, substitution, suppression or disclosure.
controls.ai_notes: Mandatory protection of critical information system assets.

evidence_requirements.name: Critical Asset Protection Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy specifying controls to prevent unauthorized access, misuse, or fraudulent modification/disclosure of critical information assets.

evidence_requirements.name: Access Control Matrix

evidence_requirements.name: DLP/Encryption Implementation Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Technical evidence of DLP, encryption and monitoring controls on critical assets.

evidence_requirements.name: Asset Protection Audit Report
evidence_requirements.description: Audit report validating protection controls on critical information assets.

controls.title: Formulate information system asset protection policy
controls.description: FIs shall formulate a policy on information system asset protection in which criticality of assets shall be identified and ascertained in order to develop appropriate protection plans.
controls.full_text: FI(s) shall formulate a policy on information system asset protection in which, criticality of information system assets shall be identified and ascertained in order to develop appropriate plans to protect them.
controls.ai_notes: Mandatory policy for asset protection with criticality assessment.

evidence_requirements.name: Information System Asset Protection Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Formal policy specifying criticality assessment methodology and protection planning.

evidence_requirements.name: Asset Criticality Assessment Methodology

evidence_requirements.name: Criticality Register

controls.description: FIs shall annually conduct a risk-based vulnerabilities identification exercise across the entire institution covering critical information systems and supporting infrastructure assets.
controls.full_text: FI(s) shall annually conduct a risk-based vulnerabilities identification exercise across the entire institution covering critical information systems and supporting infrastructure assets.
controls.ai_notes: Annual vulnerability identification exercise is mandatory.

evidence_requirements.name: Annual Vulnerability Identification Plan
evidence_requirements.description: Annual plan covering enterprise-wide, risk-based vulnerability identification across critical systems and infrastructure.

evidence_requirements.name: Vulnerability Assessment Reports
evidence_requirements.description: VA reports covering the full scope with CVSS scoring and asset-criticality mapping.

evidence_requirements.name: VA Scope Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register confirming coverage of all critical information systems and supporting infrastructure.

evidence_requirements.name: VA Remediation Tracker
evidence_requirements.description: Tracker of VA findings through to closure with retest evidence.

controls.title: Formulate list of all identified risks
controls.description: On the basis of threats and vulnerabilities, FIs shall formulate a list of all risks that may create severe harm and disruption to operations.
controls.full_text: On the basis of threats and vulnerabilities, the FI(s) shall formulate a list of all risks that may create severe harm and disruption to the operations of FI(s).
controls.ai_notes: Mandatory risk list derived from threat and vulnerability analysis.

evidence_requirements.name: Threat & Vulnerability Register

evidence_requirements.name: Severe Risk List

evidence_requirements.name: Risk List Review Log

controls.title: Perform risk analysis and quantify potential impact
controls.description: After risk identification, FIs shall perform an analysis and quantify the potential impact and consequences of vulnerabilities and associated risks on the overall business and operations.
controls.full_text: After risk identification, the FI(s) shall perform an analysis and quantify the potential impact, consequences of vulnerabilities and associated risks identified in the risk identification exercise on the overall business and operations.
controls.ai_notes: Risk analysis and impact quantification is mandatory.

evidence_requirements.name: Risk Analysis Methodology
evidence_requirements.description: Documented risk analysis methodology covering impact quantification techniques.

evidence_requirements.name: Quantified Risk Assessment Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Reports quantifying risk impact on business and operations (financial/operational/reputational).

evidence_requirements.name: Risk Prioritisation Matrix
evidence_requirements.description: Risk heat map / prioritisation matrix based on quantified impact.

evidence_requirements.name: Executive Risk Summary

controls.title: Develop methodology to assess and prioritize information security risks
controls.description: FIs shall develop a methodology to assess the impact of threats to the information security environment and prioritize all material information security risks.
controls.full_text: FI(s) shall develop a methodology to assess the impact of the threats to its information security environment and prioritize all material information security risks.
controls.ai_notes: Mandatory development of risk assessment methodology.

evidence_requirements.name: IS Risk Assessment Methodology
evidence_requirements.description: Formal methodology for assessing and prioritising information security risks with defined scoring criteria.

evidence_requirements.name: Management Approval Memo

evidence_requirements.name: Methodology Application Evidence
evidence_requirements.description: Sample completed risk assessments evidencing methodology application.

evidence_requirements.name: Methodology Review Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of periodic methodology reviews and updates.

controls.title: Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies
controls.description: FIs shall develop and implement risk mitigation and control strategies consistent with the value of information system assets and the level of risk tolerance.
controls.full_text: FI(s) shall develop and implement risk mitigation and control strategies that are consistent with the value of the information system assets and the level of risk tolerance.
controls.ai_notes: Risk mitigation strategies must be proportionate to asset value and risk tolerance.

evidence_requirements.name: Risk Appetite & Tolerance Statement
evidence_requirements.description: Board-approved risk appetite and tolerance statement for information security.

evidence_requirements.name: Risk Treatment Plans

evidence_requirements.name: Control Implementation Evidence

evidence_requirements.name: Residual Risk Tracking

controls.title: Prioritize high-risk threat and vulnerability pairings

controls.full_text: FI(s) shall give priority to threat and vulnerability pairings with high risk ranking, which can cause significant harm or impact to the FI's operations.
controls.ai_notes: High risk pairings must be prioritized for treatment.

evidence_requirements.name: Prioritised Risk Treatment Register
evidence_requirements.description: Risk register ordered by risk rating with high-rated pairings flagged for priority treatment.

evidence_requirements.name: High-Risk Remediation Plans
evidence_requirements.description: Remediation plans specifically for high-risk threat/vulnerability pairings.

evidence_requirements.name: Prioritisation Methodology

evidence_requirements.name: Management Review of High Risks
evidence_requirements.description: Management review minutes addressing high-risk pairings.

controls.title: Consider cost and effectiveness of controls
controls.description: When deciding on alternative controls and security measures, FIs shall consider costs and effectiveness with regard to the risks being mitigated.
controls.full_text: When deciding the adoption of alternative controls and security measures, the FI(s) shall also keep in view costs and effectiveness of the controls with regard to the risks being mitigated.
controls.ai_notes: Cost-benefit consideration for controls selection.

evidence_requirements.name: Control Evaluation Reports

evidence_requirements.name: Management Approval of Controls

evidence_requirements.name: ROSI Analysis
evidence_requirements.description: Return on Security Investment (ROSI) analysis for material control decisions.

controls.title: Refrain from running inadequately controlled systems
controls.description: FIs shall refrain from implementing and running a system where threats to the safety and soundness of information systems cannot be adequately controlled.
controls.full_text: FI(s) shall refrain from implementing and running a system where the threats to the safety and soundness of the information systems cannot be adequately controlled.
controls.ai_notes: Systems with inadequate controls must not be deployed.

evidence_requirements.name: Go/No-Go Security Review Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records of security go/no-go decisions for system deployments.

evidence_requirements.name: System Rejection/Deferral Log
evidence_requirements.description: Log of systems rejected or deferred due to inadequate controls.

evidence_requirements.name: Risk Acceptance Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of formally accepted risks with senior-management sign-off.

evidence_requirements.name: Pre-Deployment Risk Assessment Reports
evidence_requirements.description: Risk assessment reports performed before system deployment.

controls.description: As a risk mitigating measure, FIs may consider taking insurance cover for various insurable risks, including recovery and restoration costs.
controls.full_text: As a risk mitigating measure, the FI(s) may consider taking insurance cover for various insurable risks, including recovery and restoration costs.
controls.ai_notes: Optional risk mitigation measure using insurance.

evidence_requirements.name: Insurable Risk Analysis
evidence_requirements.description: Analysis of insurable risks and corresponding coverage decisions.

evidence_requirements.name: Insurance Review Minutes
evidence_requirements.description: Records of periodic insurance coverage adequacy reviews.

evidence_requirements.name: Insurance Renewal Schedule
evidence_requirements.description: Renewal schedule for cyber insurance and related policies.

controls.title: Asset classification and control
controls.description: FIs shall maintain an inventory of all information assets, identify information owners responsible for confidentiality, integrity and protection. Management shall implement an information classification strategy and define controls per classification. Establish secure processes for disposal and destruction of sensitive information.
controls.full_text: The FI(s) shall maintain an inventory of all information assets and identify the information owners, who shall be responsible to ensure confidentiality, integrity and protection of these assets. Further, the management shall implement an information classification strategy in accordance with the degree of sensitivity and criticality of information assets. Moreover, the FI(s) shall develop guidelines and definitions for each classification and define an appropriate set of controls and procedures for information protection in accordance with the classification scheme. In addition, the FI(s) shall establish secure processes for disposal and destruction of sensitive information in both paper and electronic media.
controls.ai_notes: Comprehensive asset classification and control requirements.

evidence_requirements.name: Information Asset Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: Comprehensive inventory of all information assets with owner, classification and retention schedule.

evidence_requirements.name: Information Classification Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy defining classification levels (e.g. Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted) with handling guidelines per level.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Owner Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register of information owners responsible for CIA of assigned assets.

evidence_requirements.name: Secure Disposal & Destruction SOP
evidence_requirements.description: SOP for secure disposal and destruction of paper and electronic media with certificates of destruction.

evidence_requirements.name: Disposal Certificates
evidence_requirements.description: Sample disposal/destruction certificates from shredding or secure wiping activities.

controls.title: Physical and environmental protection
controls.description: Physical security measures shall protect IT facilities. Critical processing facilities must be in secure areas with access restricted to authorized personnel and reviewed regularly. Environmental threats must be considered for data center locations. Environmental controls shall monitor conditions. Equipment must be protected from power failures.
controls.full_text: Physical security measures shall be in place to protect IT facilities and equipment from damage or unauthorized access. Critical information processing facilities shall be housed in secure areas such as data centers and network equipment rooms with appropriate security barriers and entry controls. Access to these areas shall be restricted to authorized personnel only and the access rights shall be reviewed and updated regularly. The FI(s) shall consider environmental threats when selecting the locations of data centers. Further, physical and environmental controls shall be implemented to monitor environmental conditions which can adversely affect the operation of information processing facilities. Moreover, FI(s) shall take adequate measures to protect equipment from power failures and electrical supply fluctuations.
controls.ai_notes: Comprehensive physical and environmental protection requirements.

evidence_requirements.name: Physical & Environmental Security Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy covering physical access controls, environmental monitoring and power protection for IT facilities.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Centre Access Register
evidence_requirements.description: Access register for data centres and network equipment rooms with authorised-personnel list and review records.

evidence_requirements.name: Environmental Monitoring Logs
evidence_requirements.description: Logs from environmental monitoring systems (temperature, humidity, water, smoke) from data centre.

evidence_requirements.name: UPS/Generator Maintenance Records
evidence_requirements.description: Records of UPS, generator and electrical stabiliser maintenance and testing.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Centre Site Risk Assessment
evidence_requirements.description: Site risk assessment addressing environmental threats considered in data centre location selection.

evidence_requirements.name: Data Centre Walkthrough Photos
evidence_requirements.description: Photographs evidencing physical security barriers, CCTV, biometric entry and environmental controls.

controls.title: Security administration and monitoring
controls.description: FIs shall put in place a security administration function with formal procedures for administering access rights and monitoring system resources. The least privilege principle shall be employed throughout IT operations. Systems and security administrators shall have no transactional authority.
controls.full_text: The FI(s) shall put in place a security administration function and set formal procedures for administering the allocation of access rights to system resources and application systems and monitoring the use of system resources to detect any unusual or unauthorized activities. Further, FI(s) shall employ the "least privilege" principle throughout IT operations. Moreover, individuals with systems and security administrator roles and privileges shall have no transactional authority.
controls.ai_notes: Security administration, least privilege, and segregation of duties requirements.

evidence_requirements.description: Segregation of duties matrix confirming admins have no transactional authority.

evidence_requirements.name: SIEM Use-Case Library
evidence_requirements.description: SIEM use-cases for detecting unusual/unauthorised activities.

controls.title: Authentication and access control
controls.description: FIs shall have an effective process to manage user authentication and access control. Authentication mechanisms shall be commensurate with information classification. Users must accept/acknowledge an Acceptable-Use Policy before using systems. Staff with security management functions shall not perform other duties creating conflict of interest.
controls.full_text: The FI(s) shall have an effective process to manage user authentication and access control. For this purpose, appropriate user authentication mechanism commensurate with the classification of information to be accessed shall be selected. Users, who can access internal systems, shall be required to accept/acknowledge an Acceptable-Use Policy (AUP) document before using a system. Staff assigned a security management function shall not perform other duties which can create any conflict of interest.
controls.ai_notes: Authentication, AUP acknowledgement, and conflict of interest requirements.

evidence_requirements.name: Segregation of Duties Register
evidence_requirements.description: Register showing security-management staff duties do not create conflicts of interest.

evidence_requirements.name: Access Review Records

controls.description: Prohibition on installation of unlicensed software.
controls.full_text: b) Prohibition on installation of unlicensed software.

controls.title: Secure configuration of hardware and software
controls.description: Implement secure configuration of hardware, operating systems, software, applications, databases and servers with all unnecessary services and programs disabled or removed.
controls.full_text: d) Secure configuration of hardware, operating systems, software, applications, databases and servers with all unnecessary services and programs disabled or removed.
controls.ai_notes: Secure configuration and hardening requirement.

controls.full_text: e) Adequate documentation of all configurations and settings of operating systems, software, databases and servers.
controls.ai_notes: Configuration documentation is mandatory.

evidence_requirements.description: CMDB extract showing current system configurations.

evidence_requirements.name: Documentation Standard

controls.description: Implement adequate logging and monitoring of systems and user activities to detect irregularities, with secure protection of logs from manipulation.
controls.full_text: f) Adequate logging and monitoring of systems and user activities to detect irregularities and secure protection of logs from manipulation.
controls.ai_notes: Mandatory logging and monitoring with log integrity protection.

evidence_requirements.name: Monitoring Alert Response Records

controls.description: FIs shall evaluate and implement appropriate controls relative to their network complexity, and deploy an effective mechanism to monitor security policy violations and atypical activities on their network.
controls.full_text: The FI(s) shall evaluate and implement appropriate controls relative to the complexity of their network. Further, the FI(s) shall deploy an effective mechanism to monitor security policy violations and atypical activities on their network.
controls.ai_notes: Network security controls proportionate to network complexity are mandatory.

evidence_requirements.name: Network Security Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy defining network security controls proportionate to network complexity.

evidence_requirements.name: Network Security Assessment Report

controls.ai_notes: Network security controls must be tailored to each security domain.

evidence_requirements.name: Domain-Specific Control Design

evidence_requirements.name: Segmentation Validation Test Report
evidence_requirements.description: Test report validating segmentation enforcement.

controls.full_text: The FI(s) shall ensure encryption at database level, storage level and during network transmission as per the classification and sensitivity of the data.
controls.ai_notes: Encryption required at database, storage and network transmission levels based on data classification.

evidence_requirements.name: Encryption Policy
evidence_requirements.description: Policy covering encryption at database, storage and network transmission levels aligned to data classification.

evidence_requirements.name: Encryption Implementation Inventory
evidence_requirements.description: Inventory of systems with encryption status (at-rest, in-transit) by data classification.

evidence_requirements.name: Key Management Procedure

controls.full_text: The FI(s) shall formulate cyber security action plan in order to anticipate, withstand, detect and respond to cyber attacks in line with international standards and best practices.

evidence_requirements.name: Cyber Security Action Plan
evidence_requirements.description: Formal cyber security action plan addressing anticipation, withstanding, detection and response to cyber attacks.

evidence_requirements.name: Board Approval of Cyber Action Plan

controls.title: Establish comprehensive testing program for information security

The results of the testing program shall be used by the FI(s) to support the improvement in their Information/cyber security. controls.title: Develop, implement and maintain enterprise-wide written BCP
controls.description: Risk management involves developing, implementing and maintaining a written enterprise-wide BCP based on comprehensive BIA and risk assessment, reviewed and approved by the board at least annually, with conditions for invocation and flexibility to respond to unanticipated threats.
controls.full_text: Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing, and reducing risk to an acceptable level through the development, implementation and maintenance of a written, enterprise-wide BCP. The BCP shall be based on a comprehensive BIA and risk assessment exercise, reviewed and approved by the board at least annually. It shall be documented in a written program and disseminated across the FI(s). The BCP shall, among other things, specify the conditions which shall prompt implementation of the plan and the process for invoking the BCP and immediate steps to be taken during a disruption. The BCP shall be flexible to respond to unanticipated threat scenarios and changing internal conditions; focused on the impact of various threats that could potentially disrupt operations rather than on specific events; BCP shall be effective in minimizing service disruptions and financial loss through the implementation of mitigation strategies.
